**ACCEPTED.** The remaining causal-bound finding is closed; I found no correctness blocker in this scoped slice.

- **Mosaic:** Delivery lookup requires a unique match on MIDI bytes and intended timestamp, then returns `actual_logical_ns` or `actual_monotonic_ns` ([lookup:82](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/external_clock_faults.py:82)). Stop and restart pass those actual timestamps into the release lower-bound assertion, with separate transport tolerances ([Stop:133](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/external_clock_faults.py:133), [restart:173](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/external_clock_faults.py:173), [assertions:67](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/external_clock_faults.py:67)).
- **Generic runner:** The same unique-delivery lookup feeds explicit lower and upper bounds for Stop and recovery Clock ([helpers:60](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/tests/external_midi_faults_native.py:60), [recovery:173](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/tests/external_midi_faults_native.py:173)).
- **Mutations:** Mosaic separately rejects release before actual Stop and restart Clock ([tests:62](/home/andy/projects/mosaic-behaviour-tests/tests/behaviour/test_external_clock_fault_oracle.py:62)); generic tests reject both early and excessively late output ([tests:29](/home/andy/projects/monome-emulator-midi-clock/tests/test_external_midi_fault_output.py:29)).

Both repository diffs and recent history were inspected. All 14 referenced manifest hashes, 180 Mosaic artifact hashes, and checked mutation/unit-log hashes matched. Retained Mosaic traces show nonnegative causal release delays in both modes; real-time recovery released 32,790 ns after its actual Clock delivery.

**CONFIDENCE: High.** Assessment uses inspected code and retained evidence; no tests or runtime processes were launched.
